host.label: Computer
host.description: Filled in by the setup command on your computer. One or more address:port entries, comma-separated (e.g. Wi-Fi, then USB 10.0.4.21:8790); the bar uses the first that answers.

token.label: Token
token.description: Filled in by the setup command on your computer and must match its token. FAQ: https://github.com/mrlunev/busybar-claude-code#faq

context_bar.label: Context bar
context_bar.description: A thin line along the bottom that shows how full the session's context window is.
